# World-tag ring declaration -- which [Ring N / LAYER] value each path class
# may declare in its file-header tag.
#
# Read by scripts/checks/check_world_tags.py. Until #842 the gate only checked
# that a [Ring N / NAME] tag was PRESENT: the number and the layer name were
# required, written, and then never read, so a HAL driver could declare any
# ring at all and the gate stayed green. libs/ra8_hal/src/ra8_eth_media.c did
# exactly that, sitting at [Ring 2 / HAL] among 270 [Ring 3 / HAL] siblings.
#
# A "measured" row binds every file in that path class to one ring pair; the
# gate reports any file that disagrees. An "unmeasured" row records a class
# whose declared rings are NOT uniform in the tree today, so the remaining gap
# is enumerated here instead of being invisible. Every path class in
# RING_CLASSES must carry one row or the other: a class missing from this file
# is a setup failure, never an implicit pass. Rows move from unmeasured to
# measured by making the tree uniform first, never by relaxing this file.
#
# Ring numbering is the coordinate system in docs/RING_AND_WORLD.md.
#
#! measured libs/ra8_hal/: Ring 3 / HAL
#! measured libs/ra8_nsc/: Ring 4 / NSC
#! measured libs/ra8_secure_app/: Ring 5 / SECAPP
#
# Unmeasured, with what the tree declares today (counts at the commit that
# introduced this file, kept as review context, not as a bound):
#   libs/ra8_core/    Ring 0 / Foundation (4), Ring 1 / BOOT (1),
#                     Ring 1 / CORE (1), Ring 1 / Core (4)
#   libs/ra8_*_pal/   Ring 3 / PAL (1), Ring 4 / Display (2), Ring 4 / PAL (11)
#   tests/            Ring 1, 3, 4, 6, 7 across 11 layer names
#   examples/         Ring 1 / Boot (20), Ring 1 / app (15), Ring 6 / APP (314),
#                     Ring 6 / App (15), Ring 7 / App (28)
#   apps/             Ring 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 across 12 layer names
#   libs/ (other)     Ring 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 across 14 layer names
#   * (port/, tools/) Ring 4, 5, 7 across 5 layer names
#
#! unmeasured libs/ra8_core/
#! unmeasured libs/ra8_*_pal/
#! unmeasured tests/
#! unmeasured examples/
#! unmeasured apps/
#! unmeasured libs/
#! unmeasured *
